questiontext.text:
How do you access the value 50 in this Series?

s = pd.Series([50, 100], index=["A", "B"])

correctfeedback.text: Correct! Labels can be used for indexing.

incorrectfeedback.text: Incorrect. Remember that Pandas Series support label-based indexing. s["A"] Correct.
